description: ESP32-S3 N16R8 (16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM), native Wi-Fi, no display. Pins: docs/S3_PORT.md.

sdmmc_slots.label: microSD, SDMMC slot 1 through the GPIO matrix; the pins follow the card's own order. Fit 10k pull-ups on CMD/D0-D3

gpio_outputs.label: Amp /RESET + PCM5102A XSMT (low = mute, ext. pull-down)

i2s_buses.label: I2S0 out to the PCM5102A; S3 is master, the rate follows the source; no MCLK. DIN is the satellite's data line: the receive side exists for clocking the BT link
I2S1 in from the BT satellite. Below link 1.9 the satellite is master; from 1.9 I2S0 drives BCLK/WS (GPIO15/16). Width opened at its maximum (32-bit); 160 MHz clocks it at 48 kHz

uart_buses.label: Control link to the BT satellite (its GPIO16/17). Wire format: docs/LINK_PROTOCOL.md
